title: Overseeing Functioning of State and District Commissions

content.scenario: The National Commission decides to oversee the functioning of the State Commission of Gujarat by conducting an inspection. The inspection reveals some irregularities in the functioning of the State Commission, which are then addressed by the National Commission.
content.outcome: The National Commission oversees the functioning of the State Commission of Gujarat, ensuring that it is functioning in accordance with the prescribed standards and procedures, and takes corrective action to address any irregularities found during the inspection.

user_queries: How does the National Commission oversee State Commissions?
What is the purpose of inspecting State Commissions?
Can the National Commission take corrective action against State Commissions?
